_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score stays in Disbelief band while momentum/funding pinned and 30d return near flat; crowding is a warning inside the coil, not a breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative only flags long-leaning account ratios, no opposing forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC range-bound, funding near flat, fear_greed holds 55-62
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed <54 on netflow/vol flush (Complacency) or momentum/funding lift through 63 (Hope)
